ledger.x: 25 August 1580: Philip II of Spain claims the crown of Portugal and the Iberian Union begins.
1580: the Spanish crowns are absorbed into the union (the kingdom-of-spain dossier records the matching merge in 1580).
25 August 1580: Alba defeats the Prior of Crato at Alcântara and takes Lisbon.
1581: the Cortes of Tomar make Philip king of Portugal.
1581: the mainland of Portugal is recognised as Philip's.
1582 (bridging, confidence 1): the union inherits the war with the Republic.
July 1582: the fight for the Azores.
1583: António's attempt to rule from Terceira 'came to an end in 1583'.
1583: the Azores pass to Philip II, completing the Portuguese Succession war.
1585: Parma retakes Flanders and Brabant.
17 August 1585: Antwerp surrenders to Parma.
1588 (bridging, confidence 1): the north-east of the Netherlands is drawn Spanish.
1590: the Dutch take Breda.
1591: the Dutch take Zutphen, Deventer, Delfzijl and Nijmegen: 'Zutphen, Deventer, Delfzijl, and Nijmegen in 1591'.
1592: the Dutch take Steenwijk and Coevorden: 'Steenwijk and Coevorden in 1592'.
1594: the Dutch take Groningen: 'Groningen in 1594'.
1597: the Dutch take Grol (Groenlo), Enschede, Ootmarsum and Oldenzaal: 'and Grol, Enschede, Ootmarsum, and Oldenzaal in 1597'.
1601: the siege of Ostend begins.
1601: the court moves from Madrid to Valladolid: 'transferred to Valladolid, with the whole administrative staff'; destination in identity.capitals.
1602: Bahrain is lost to Persia.
1604: the siege of Ostend ends in a Spanish success (the page gives no result beyond 'successes').
1604: Ostend, the Republic's foothold on the Flemish coast, is Spanish again.
1606: the court returns to Madrid (the end of the page's 1601-1606 span; the return itself is the researcher's reading).
1606 (confidence 2): Spinola's campaign brings Oldenzaal and Groenlo back under Spain.
9 April 1609: the Twelve Years' Truce.
August 1620: Spanish troops enter the Lower Palatinate.
1621: the war with the Republic resumes.
1625: Spain takes Breda.
1626: the Dutch conquer Oldenzaal: 'the eastern border forts of Oldenzaal (1626) and Groenlo (1627)'.
1627: the Dutch conquer Groenlo ('Oldenzaal (1626) and Groenlo (1627)').
1629: the Dutch take 's-Hertogenbosch: 'the major Brabantian city of 's-Hertogenbosch (1629)'.
1632: the Dutch take the Meuse towns: 'the fortified cities of Venlo, Roermond and Maastricht along the Meuse (1632)'.
1632 (bridging, confidence 1): Cliopatria drops the Palatinate cells.
19 May 1635: France declares war on Spain.
1636 (bridging, confidence 1): Cliopatria restores the Palatinate cells.
August 1636: the Spanish reach Corbie.
1636: the incursion ends.
1637: the Dutch retake Breda: 'the Dutch took it back in 1637'.
1637: the Cardinal-Infante retakes Venlo and Roermond.
1640: Catalonia rises against Philip IV.
1 December 1640: Portugal recovers its independence.
1640 (closing the pair, confidence 1): the union dissolves; the page has the war with the Republic end only on 30 January 1648 (infobox 'c.
1640 (closing the pair, confidence 1): the union dissolves; the Franco-Spanish War runs to 7 November 1659 under the kingdom-of-spain dossier.
1640 (closing the pair, confidence 1): the pages opened do not say when the Spanish left the Palatinate; the Peace of Westphalia is 24 October 1648 on the page.
1 December 1640: the Iberian Union ends.

wars.name: War of the Portuguese Succession
wars.outcome: Victory for Philip II: Alcântara (25 August 1580), Lisbon two days later, recognition at the Cortes of Tomar (1581), the Azores by 1583; 'Establishment of the Iberian Union'.

wars.name: Eighty Years' War
wars.outcome: Dutch captures of 1590-1597 and 1626-1637; truce of 9 April 1609 to 1621; Peace of Münster, 30 January 1648 (after the union), where Spain recognised the Republic.

wars.name: Thirty Years' War (Spanish campaigns on the Rhine and in the Netherlands)
wars.outcome: Spanish and imperial troops hold most of the Palatinate by November 1622 (Frankenthal falls in March 1623); France enters in May 1635; Peace of Westphalia 24 October 1648.

wars.name: Franco-Spanish War (1635-1659)
wars.outcome: Spanish incursion to Corbie in August 1636, then stalemate 1637-1659; Treaty of the Pyrenees gives France Artois, Hainaut towns and Roussillon.

wars.name: Reapers' War
wars.outcome: The Bloody Corpus (1640), the Catalan Republic under French protection (17 January 1641), Spanish recapture of Barcelona in 1652; Roussillon and northern Cerdanya ceded to France in 1659.

wars.name: Portuguese Restoration War
wars.outcome: Portugal recovers independence: revolution of 1 December 1640; Spain 'recognized Portugal's sovereignty and made peace on 13 February 1668'; Ceuta stays with Spain.

certainty.note: The shapes are Cliopatria's approximations of a composite monarchy (Spain, Portugal, the Italian dominions, the Low Countries).
